# Declared forms closure witness

Disabled exposes wire roots only. Allowed and Holder expose JSON and cook roots
while reaching Disabled by value, as a map value, and through a pointer across
source files. Allowed also exposes its block form. Disabled must retain the
storage and internal walkers those parents need without regaining disabled
public roots. The native form-mask tests separately cover all eight combinations
of JSON, block, and cook while keeping variable, fixed, and message wire active.
